Warehousing

สถานีแยกพาเลท

A location within warehouse operations where palletized goods are unstacked and sorted for storage, cross-docking, or repackaging, cited in inbound receipt procedures and material handling records.

Quick answer: A location within warehouse operations where palletized goods are unstacked and sorted for storage, cross-docking, or repackaging, cited in inbound receipt procedures and material handling records.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A location within warehouse operations where palletized goods are unstacked and sorted for storage, cross-docking, or repackaging, cited in inbound receipt procedures and material handling records.

Operational example

Products from suppliers are offloaded at the depalletizing station for inspection and putaway.
